name: Daily Evening Brief
description: End-of-day summary of activities, tasks, and follow-ups
prompt:
Generate today's summary:

1. Read memory/${TODAY}.md
2. Summarize:
   - Key conversations and decisions
   - Tasks completed today
   - Tasks added but incomplete
   - Follow-ups created
   - Notable insights
3. Append summary to memory/${TODAY}.md under ## Daily Summary
4. Identify any urgent follow-ups for tomorrow
5. Send brief summary to primary channel

Format: Clear, bullet points, action-oriented.
notes: Adjust schedule to your local evening time. Use 22:00 (10 PM) as default.

name: Weekly Review
description: Sunday evening reflection on the past week
prompt:
Conduct weekly review:

1. Read all memory files from the past 7 days
2. Generate weekly summary:
   - Major themes and accomplishments
   - Tasks completed vs. incomplete
   - Patterns observed (blockers, productivity peaks)
   - Important learnings
3. Update MEMORY.md with distilled insights
4. Create follow-up list for next week
5. Archive logs older than 30 days to memory/archive/
6. Send comprehensive weekly report

Format: Narrative style, reflective, forward-looking.
notes: Runs Sunday 8 PM. Good time for week-ahead planning.

name: Active Projects Check-In
description: Every 3 days, review status of active projects
prompt:
Check active projects:

1. List all files in projects/ folder
2. For each active project:
   - Last activity date
   - Current status
   - Blockers or delays
   - Next action required
3. Flag:
   - Projects with no activity >5 days
   - Approaching deadlines (<3 days out)
   - Waiting on external input >7 days
4. Send summary only if action needed

Format: Concise, flag only what needs attention.
notes: Runs every 3 days at 10 AM. Only messages if something needs attention.

name: Follow-Up Reminder Check
description: Daily scan for follow-ups that are due
prompt:
Check follow-up reminders:

1. Search memory/ for 'FOLLOW-UP:' tags
2. Parse date and action for each
3. List all follow-ups due today or overdue
4. For each due item:
   - Original context
   - Action needed
   - Days since created
5. Send reminder only if items are due

Format: Actionable list with context links.
notes: Morning reminder for same-day follow-ups. Only messages if items are due.

name: Monthly Goals Review
description: First Monday of each month, review progress on monthly goals
prompt:
Monthly goals review:

1. Read MEMORY.md section on current month's goals
2. Review past 30 days of memory logs
3. Assess:
   - Progress on each goal
   - Percentage complete
   - Blockers encountered
   - Adjustments needed
4. Update MEMORY.md with progress notes
5. Suggest priorities for next month
6. Send comprehensive monthly report

Format: Reflective, analytical, goal-oriented.
notes: Runs first Monday of each month at 9 AM. Targets dates 1-7 on Mondays.

name: Context Refresh Reminder
description: Prompt to update MEMORY.md with recent insights (every 2 weeks)
prompt:
Memory refresh reminder:

1. Review memory logs from past 14 days
2. Identify:
   - Recurring themes or decisions
   - Lessons learned
   - Changed priorities or preferences
   - New information to retain long-term
3. Draft updates for MEMORY.md
4. Present suggested updates for approval
5. After approval, update MEMORY.md

Format: Curated insights, not raw logs.
notes: Every 2 weeks at 3 PM. Keeps long-term memory current and relevant.

name: Stale Project Alert
description: Weekly check for projects with no activity in 2+ weeks
prompt:
Stale project scan:

1. Check all files in projects/
2. Identify projects with no edits in 14+ days
3. For each stale project:
   - Last activity date
   - Original objective
   - Current status if known
4. Ask: Should this be archived, re-prioritized, or resumed?
5. Send report only if stale projects exist

Format: Simple list with options.
notes: Wednesday mid-day check. Helps prevent forgotten projects.

name: Weekend Planning
description: Friday afternoon prep for the weekend and next week
prompt:
Weekend planning:

1. Review this week's accomplishments
2. List incomplete tasks from this week
3. Check calendar for next week's events
4. Identify top 3 priorities for Monday
5. Flag any urgent items needing weekend attention
6. Send concise weekend brief

Format: Short, actionable, forward-looking.
notes: Friday 4 PM. Helps transition into weekend with clear mind.
